Together we can make the world a better place for animals
FourGive
 is a Swiss charity founded by Lydia & Viktor Ackermann, running the only vet clinic for stray animals and pets in Marsa Alam, serving 500km of coastline in the south of Egypt and countless stray & farm animals.
Thank you for your support and your trust! 
Vet Clinic Marsa Alam
Emergencies, treatment of sick and injured animals, TNVR and more. We treat stray animals in Marsa Alam for free, thanks to your donations 
and our dedicated founders, and offer affordable treatments for local 
pet owners with our very committed team.
We already treated > 2000 animals since we started in November 2024.
 Lern more about our services...
Our values
100% OF YOUR DONATION GOES TOWARDS ANIMALS
Our founders cover all operational costs for the administration of the foundation.
WE SUPPORT ANIMAL PROJECTS - AND THAT'S IT
We support projects for animals and their habitats outside Europe - and nothing else 
EVERY LIFE MATTERS
Stray animals don't have it easy, and still many fight desperately for that miserable little life. 
We pay attention and treat it with care.
